scope: Post-target follow-up metadata index. No candidate installation, execution, cloning or third-party skill-body import.
counting_notes: Each repository counts once by canonical full_name and available repository ID against the fixed 2344 baseline.

The 38 entries were independently reviewed by product/registry, science/GIS/CAE, and design/workflow reviewers; README, installation or distribution evidence, representative SKILL.md or infrastructure contract, and license scope were checked.
Skill counts preserve repository-specific semantics; routers, templates, generated/client copies, fixtures and maintenance helpers are not counted as independent skills.
This follow-up is cumulative with the 76 repositories in part83; it does not alter the already achieved daily target claim.
